name: budget_variance
description: Line items from a budget analysis report comparing a prior-year budget, a prior-year reforecast and the new budget. One row per detail line with a GL code. Section headers and total rows are not rows.

property_name.name: Property
property_name.original: Property name from the report header. Same for every row.
property_name.description: Extract the property name from the report header. This value is the same for every row.

property_rsf.name: Property RSF
property_rsf.original: Property rentable square footage from the header, as a number. Same for every row.
property_rsf.description: Extract the property’s rentable square footage from the report header as a number. This value is the same for every row.

budget_year.name: Budget Year
budget_year.original: The year of the new budget being analysed, as a four-digit number. Same for every row.
budget_year.description: Extract the year of the new budget being analysed as a four-digit year. This value is the same for every row.

gl_code.name: GL Code
gl_code.original: General ledger account code of the line, exactly as shown, e.g. 6101-0000. One per row.
gl_code.description: Extract the general ledger account code of the line exactly as shown, e.g. 6101-0000. There is one code per row. Include only detail lines with a GL code; exclude section headers and total rows.

line_item.name: Line Item
line_item.original: Account name of the line exactly as shown.
line_item.description: Extract the account name of the line exactly as shown. Include only detail lines with a GL code; exclude section headers and total rows.

section.name: Section
section.original: The nearest bold section header above the line, e.g. 'Rent Revenue', 'Cleaning Expenses'. Exactly as shown.
section.description: Extract the nearest bold section header above the line exactly as shown, e.g. 'Rent Revenue', 'Cleaning Expenses'. Include only detail lines with a GL code; exclude section headers and total rows.

prior_year_budget.name: Prior Year Budget
prior_year_budget.original: The line's value in the prior-year budget column, as a number.
prior_year_budget.description: Extract the line’s value in the prior-year budget column as a number. Exclude section headers and total rows; include only detail lines with a GL code.

prior_year_reforecast.name: Prior Year Reforecast
prior_year_reforecast.original: The line's value in the prior-year reforecast column, as a number.
prior_year_reforecast.description: Extract the line’s value in the prior-year reforecast column as a number. Exclude section headers and total rows; include only detail lines with a GL code.

budget.name: Budget
budget.original: The line's value in the new budget column, as a number.
budget.description: Extract the line’s value in the new budget column as a number. Exclude section headers and total rows; include only detail lines with a GL code.

reforecast_vs_prior_budget_variance.name: Reforecast vs Prior Budget (amount)
reforecast_vs_prior_budget_variance.original: Dollar variance of the prior-year reforecast against the prior-year budget, as a number with its sign as printed.
reforecast_vs_prior_budget_variance.description: Extract the dollar variance of the prior-year reforecast against the prior-year budget as a number, preserving its sign as printed. Exclude section headers and total rows; include only detail lines with a GL code.

reforecast_vs_prior_budget_pct.name: Reforecast vs Prior Budget (%)
reforecast_vs_prior_budget_pct.original: Percentage variance of the prior-year reforecast against the prior-year budget, as a number exactly as printed, e.g. -46.78. null when the report prints N/A.
reforecast_vs_prior_budget_pct.description: Extract the percentage variance of the prior-year reforecast against the prior-year budget as a number exactly as printed, e.g. -46.78. Return null when the report prints N/A. Exclude section headers and total rows; include only detail lines with a GL code.

budget_vs_reforecast_variance.name: Budget vs Reforecast (amount)
budget_vs_reforecast_variance.original: Dollar variance of the new budget against the prior-year reforecast, as a number with its sign as printed.
budget_vs_reforecast_variance.description: Extract the dollar variance of the new budget against the prior-year reforecast as a number, preserving its sign as printed. Exclude section headers and total rows; include only detail lines with a GL code.

budget_vs_reforecast_pct.name: Budget vs Reforecast (%)
budget_vs_reforecast_pct.original: Percentage variance of the new budget against the prior-year reforecast, as a number exactly as printed. null when the report prints N/A.
budget_vs_reforecast_pct.description: Extract the percentage variance of the new budget against the prior-year reforecast as a number exactly as printed. Return null when the report prints N/A. Exclude section headers and total rows; include only detail lines with a GL code.

explanation_of_variance.name: Explanation of Variance
explanation_of_variance.original: The management commentary printed in the Explanation of Variance column for this line, verbatim. null if the column is empty for the line.
explanation_of_variance.description: Extract the management commentary printed in the Explanation of Variance column for this line, verbatim. Return null if the column is empty for the line. Exclude section headers and total rows; include only detail lines with a GL code.
